cases.sentence: В тот ___ ты скажешь, «Славлю тебя, Господь!»
cases.translation: In that day you will say, "I praise you, Lord!"
cases.explain: день is a time expression with в (in), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ты гневался на меня, но отвратил свой ___ и утешил меня.
cases.translation: You were angry with me, but turned away your wrath and comforted me.
cases.explain: гнев is the direct object of отвратил (turned away), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Истинно, Бог — ___ мое, буду надеяться на него.
cases.translation: Truly, God is my salvation, I will trust in him.
cases.explain: спасение is a predicate nominative with Бог, requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: The Lord is my strength and song.
cases.explain: сила is a predicate nominative with Господь, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Радостно будете черпать ___ из колодцев спасения.
cases.translation: You will joyfully draw water from the wells of salvation.
cases.explain: воду is the direct object of черпать (draw), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пойте Господу, пусть это откроется всей ___.
cases.translation: Sing to the Lord, let this be known in all the earth.
cases.explain: земле follows the preposition по (throughout), requiring prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Кричите и пойте от ___, жители Сиона.
cases.translation: Cry aloud and shout for joy, you inhabitants of Zion.
cases.explain: радости follows от (from), which requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Славьте Господа! Призывайте Его ___! Возглашайте в народах Его деяния!
cases.translation: Praise the Lord! Call on his name! Proclaim his deeds!
cases.explain: имя is the direct object of Призывайте (call upon), requiring accusative case.

reading.ru: В тот день ты скажешь, «Славлю тебя, Господь! Ты гневался на меня, но отвратил свой гнев и утешил меня.
reading.question: What will happen on that day?
options: People will give thanks to the Lord for turning away his anger and comforting them
The Lord will destroy all nations
reading.correct: People will give thanks to the Lord for turning away his anger and comforting them
reading.explain: The verse describes a day of thanksgiving when the Lord comforts his people.

reading.ru: Истинно, Бог — спасение мое, буду надеяться на него и не стану бояться.
reading.question: What are the people prepared to do?
options: Trust in God and not fear
reading.correct: Trust in God and not fear
reading.explain: The verse shows confidence and trust in God as their salvation.

reading.ru: Радостно будете черпать воду из колодцев спасения.
reading.question: What will they do with joy?
options: Draw water from the wells of salvation
reading.correct: Draw water from the wells of salvation
reading.explain: The passage describes joyfully drawing water from wells of salvation.

reading.ru: Пойте Господу, ведь Он совершил великое, пусть это откроется всей земле.
reading.question: What should be known throughout the earth?
options: The great deeds God has done
reading.correct: The great deeds God has done
reading.explain: The verse calls people to proclaim God's great works to all the earth.

reading.ru: Кричите и пойте от радости, жители Сиона, потому что велик среди вас, святой Израилев.
reading.question: Why should the inhabitants of Zion shout and sing?
options: Because the Holy One of Israel is great among them
Because they will build a great city
reading.correct: Because the Holy One of Israel is great among them
reading.explain: The people are called to rejoice because God's presence is great in their midst.

reading.ru: Господь! Господь — моя сила и песнь, Он стал мне спасением.
reading.question: What is the Lord to the speaker?
reading.explain: The verse declares the Lord as the speaker's strength, song, and salvation.
